pairs: Abiit autem Abimelech filius Jerobaal in Sichem ad fratres matris suæ,
Now Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, went to Shechem,
et ad omnem cognationem domus patris matris suæ,
and he spoke to them, and to all the relatives of the house of his maternal grandfather,
“Speak to all the men of Shechem:
ut dominentur vestri septuaginta viri omnes filii Jerobaal,
that seventy men, all the sons of Jerubbaal, should rule over you,
an ut dominetur unus vir? simulque considerate quod os vestrum et caro vestra sum.
or that one man should rule over you? And consider also that I am your bone and your flesh.”
Locutique sunt fratres matris ejus de eo ad omnes viros Sichem universos sermones istos,
And his maternal brothers spoke about him to all the men of Shechem, all these words,
et inclinaverunt cor eorum post Abimelech,
and they inclined their hearts after Abimelech,
Dederuntque illi septuaginta pondo argenti de fano Baalberit.
And they gave to him the weight of seventy silver coins from the shrine of Baal-berith.
Qui conduxit sibi ex eo viros inopes
he hired for himself indigent and wandering men,
Et venit in domum patris sui in Ephra,
And he went to his father’s house in Ophrah,
et occidit fratres suos filios Jerobaal,
and he killed his brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal,
And there remained only Joatham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal,
Congregati sunt autem omnes viri Sichem,
Then all the men of Shechem gathered together,
and all the families of the city of Millo,
and they went and appointed Abimelech as king,
juxta quercum quæ stabat in Sichem.
beside the oak that stood at Shechem.
When this had been reported to Jotham,
et stetit in vertice montis Garizim:
and stood at the top of Mount Gerizim.
so that God may listen to you.
Ierunt ligna, ut ungerent super se regem:
The trees went to anoint a king over themselves.
And they said to the olive tree,
qua et dii utuntur et homines,
which both gods and men make use of,
et venire ut inter ligna promovear?
and depart to be promoted among the trees?’
And the trees said to the fig tree,
and accept royal power over us.’
et ire ut inter cetera ligna promovear?
and depart to be promoted among the other trees?’
And the trees said to the vine,
which gives joy to God and men,
and be promoted among the other trees?’
And all the trees said to the bramble,
Si vere me regem vobis constituitis,
‘If truly you would appoint me as king,
But if you are not willing,
let fire go forth from the bramble,
and let it devour the cedars of Lebanon.’”
if you are upright and without sin in appointing Abimelech as a king over you,
et absque peccato constituistis super vos regem Abimelech,
and if you have acted well with Jerubbaal,
the benefits of him who fought on your behalf,
and who gave his life to dangers,
ut erueret vos de manu Madian,
so that he might rescue you from the hand of Midian,
qui nunc surrexistis contra domum patris mei,
though you now have risen up against my father’s house,
et interfecistis filios ejus septuaginta viros super unum lapidem,
and have killed his sons, seventy men, upon one stone,
et constituistis regem Abimelech filium ancillæ ejus super habitatores Sichem,
and have appointed Abimelech, the son of his handmaid, as a king over the inhabitants of Shechem,
si ergo recte et absque vitio egistis cum Jerobaal et domo ejus,
if therefore you are upright and have acted without fault with Jerubbaal and his house,
then you should rejoice on this day in Abimelech,
and he should rejoice in you.
But if you have acted perversely,
may fire go forth from him
and consume the inhabitants of Shechem
And may fire go forth from the men of Shechem
and from the town of Millo,
And when he had said these things,
he fled and went away to Beer.
habitavitque ibi ob metum Abimelech fratris sui.
And he lived in that place, out of fear of Abimelech, his brother.
Regnavit itaque Abimelech super Israël tribus annis.
And so Abimelech reigned over Israel for three years.
Misitque Dominus spiritum pessimum inter Abimelech et habitatores Sichem:
And the Lord put a very grievous spirit between Abimelech and the inhabitants of Shechem,
et scelus interfectionis septuaginta filiorum Jerobaal,
and to place blame for the crime of the killing of the seventy sons of Jerubbaal,
et effusionem sanguinis eorum conferre in Abimelech fratrem suum,
and for the shedding of their blood, upon Abimelech, their brother,
et in ceteros Sichimorum principes, qui eum adjuverant.
and upon the rest of the leaders of the Shechemites, who assisted him.
Posueruntque insidias adversus eum in summitate montium:
And they stationed an ambush against him at the summit of the mountains.
And while they were waiting for his arrival,
taking spoils from those passing by.
And this was reported to Abimelech.
Venit autem Gaal filius Obed cum fratribus suis,
Now Gaal, the son of Ebed, went with his brothers,
Ad cujus adventum erecti habitatores Sichem,
And the inhabitants of Shechem, uplifted by his arrival,
they entered into the shrine of their god.
And Gaal, the son of Ebed,
Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, who has appointed Zebul,
et constituit principem Zebul servum suum super viros Emor patris Sichem?
his servant, as ruler over the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem?
Why then should we serve him?
utinam daret aliquis populum istum sub manu mea,
I wish that someone would set this people under my hand,
so that I might take away Abimelech from their midst.”
And it was told to Abimelech,
For Zebul, the ruler of the city,
upon hearing the words of Gaal, the son of Ebed,
et misit clam ad Abimelech nuntios,
And he sent messengers secretly to Abimelech, saying:
Ecce Gaal filius Obed venit in Sichimam cum fratribus suis,
Gaal, the son of Ebed, has arrived at Shechem with his brothers,
and he has set the city against you.
Surge itaque nocte cum populo qui tecum est,
And so, rise up in the night, with the people who are with you,
and lie hidden in the field.
And at first light in the morning,
Illo autem egrediente adversum te cum populo suo,
rush upon the city. And when he goes out against you, with his people,
do to him what you are able to do.”
Surrexit itaque Abimelech cum omni exercitu suo nocte,
And so Abimelech rose up, with all his army, by night,
et tetendit insidias juxta Sichimam in quatuor locis.
and he set ambushes near Shechem in four places.
And Gaal, the son of Ebed, went out,
et stetit in introitu portæ civitatis. Surrexit autem Abimelech,
and he stood at the entrance to the gate of the city. Then Abimelech rose up,
et omnis exercitus cum eo, de insidiarum loco.
and all the army with him, from the places of the ambushes.
And when Gaal had seen the people,
a multitude is descending from the mountains.”
Umbras montium vides quasi capita hominum,
“You are seeing the shadows of the mountains, as if they were the heads of men,
and so you are being deceived by this error.”
Ecce populus de umbilico terræ descendit,
a people is descending from the middle of the land,
et unus cuneus venit per viam quæ respicit quercum.
and one company is arriving by the way that looks towards the oak.”
Quis est Abimelech ut serviamus ei?
‘Who is Abimelech that we should serve him?’
nonne hic populus est, quem despiciebas?
Is this not the people that you were despising?
Go out and fight against him.”
with the people of Shechem watching,
and drove him into the city.
And many were cut down on his side,
even to the gate of the city.
And Abimelech made camp at Arumah.
Zebul autem Gaal et socios ejus expulit de urbe,
But Zebul expelled Gaal and his companions from the city,
nec in ea passus est commorari.
and he would not permit them to remain in it.
the people departed into the field.
And when this had been reported to Abimelech,
and divided it into three companies,
and he placed ambushes in the fields.
Vidensque quod egrederetur populus de civitate,
And seeing that the people had departed from the city,
duæ autem turmæ palantes per campum adversarios persequebantur.
But the two other companies pursued the enemies scattered in the field.
Porro Abimelech omni die illo oppugnabat urbem:
Now Abimelech assaulted the city all that day.
ita ut sal in ea dispergeret.
so much so that he scattered salt in it.
Quod cum audissent qui habitabant in turre Sichimorum,
And when those living in the tower of Shechem had heard about this,
ingressi sunt fanum dei sui Berith,
they entered the temple of their god, Berith,
where they had formed a covenant with him.
et ex eo locus nomen acceperat:
And it was because of this, that the place had taken its name.
Abimelech quoque audiens viros turris Sichimorum pariter conglobatos,
Abimelech, also hearing that the men of the tower of Shechem had joined together,
ascendit in montem Selmon cum omni populo suo:
ascended to mount Zalmon, with all his people. And taking an axe,
he cut down the branch of a tree.
And laying it on his shoulder,
impositumque ferens humero, dixit ad socios:
and carrying it, he said to his companions,
Quod me videtis facere, cito facite.
“What you see me do, you must do quickly.”
Igitur certatim ramos de arboribus præcidentes,
eagerly cutting down branches from the trees,
the occupants of the tower of Shechem.
Abimelech autem inde proficiscens venit ad oppidum Thebes,
Then Abimelech, setting out from there, arrived at the town of Thebez,
which he surrounded and besieged with his army.
Erat autem turris excelsa in media civitate,
Now there was, in the midst of the city, a high tower,
ad quam confugerant simul viri ac mulieres,
to which men and women were fleeing together,
with all the leaders of the city. And,
having very strongly sealed the gate,
et super turris tectum stantes per propugnacula.
they were standing on the roof of the tower to defend themselves.
And Abimelech, drawing near the tower,
he strove to set it on fire.
et ecce una mulier fragmen molæ desuper jaciens,
And behold, one woman, throwing a fragment of a millstone from above,
And he quickly called to his armor bearer,
otherwise it may be said that I was slain by a woman.”
ne forte dicatur quod a femina interfectus sim.
omnes qui cum eo erant de Israël, reversi sunt in sedes suas:
all those of Israel who were with him returned to their homes.
et reddidit Deus malum quod fecerat Abimelech contra patrem suum, interfectis septuaginta fratribus suis.
And so did God repay the evil that Abimelech had done against his father by killing his seventy brothers.
Sichimitis quoque quod operati erant, retributum est,
The Shechemites also were given retribution for what they had done,
et venit super eos maledictio Joatham filii Jerobaal.
and the curse of Jotham, the son of Jerubbaal, fell upon them.
